resource_gate: PASS for frozen pure integer helper and unchanged geometry hot callsites; GPU execution not performed

review.div_loop: Exactly 62 fractional digits (bit61..0), one subtraction test per digit. Remainder below normalized denominator before doubling.
review.sqrt_loop: Exactly 63 radix4 pairs (pair62..0), fixed one correction; guarded variable shift branch.
review.heap: Hot new/new[] counter unchanged across warmup and all timed loops; helper allocation names and non-helper function calls rejected statically. Does not instrument libc malloc directly; helper whitelist prohibits malloc/calloc/realloc.
review.resident_path: Only offline probe calls added; geometry submit/finish and Context::shared bodies retain historical identity as checked by existing resource tests. No production geometry callsite switch, buffers, readback, dispatch or waits added by these arithmetic helpers.

measurement_scope.method: Alternating native/software order; volatile function-pointer calls to noinline wrappers; native volatile IEEE division/sqrt and canonical NaNs; FE_TONEAREST and x86 FTZ/DAZ disabled. Checksums and pointwise parity outside timing.
measurement_scope.positive_sqrt: Ordinary and subnormal square-root inputs are positive, ensuring recurrence rather than negative-domain early return. Special population intentionally mixes special/finite values.
measurement_scope.cost: Amortized per-call wall/processCPU includes indirect call, load and checksum. Not serial dependency latency or pure instruction cost.
measurement_scope.host_control: No affinity, power or host workload reservation. No target CPU/GPU, camera, ROS, station throughput or headroom claim.

development_history: Initial harness compilation failed from inconsistent lambda inferred unsigned integer types; explicit uint64_t return fixed it. No helper algorithm changed.
Preliminary ordinary sqrt population included negative inputs. Final measurement uses positive finite ordinary/subnormal sqrt and supersedes that mixed-domain trial.
